about_text:
Nestled in the breathtaking Fergana Valley of Uzbekistan, Chortoq Boutique Hotel is a refined 4-star retreat designed for discerning travelers seeking comfort, elegance, and personalized service. Blending contemporary sophistication with local charm, the hotel offers an exclusive collection of elegantly appointed rooms and suites, including Deluxe Duplex Suites and a Presidential Suite, each thoughtfully crafted to provide a luxurious stay.

Guests can indulge in exceptional culinary experiences at all-day-dining restaurant, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere at Bonjour Lobby Lounge, or unwind at Bar Teca and La Terrace. For exclusive gatherings, the Ambassadors VIP Dining Room offers a refined private setting. Business travelers will find state-of-the-art facilities, including a conference hall and two meeting rooms, perfect for corporate events and intimate meetings.

With a curated shopping arcade, world-class amenities, and a serene landscaped environment, Chortoq Boutique Hotel redefines hospitality, offering an unforgettable stay in the heart of Uzbekistan.
exclusive_offers_description: Unlock unique experiences, inspiring places and exclusive Chortoq Loyalty Programme member rates. Turn your travel into a refreshing journey where every stay is an opportunity to explore breathtaking destinations.
featured_hotels_text: Step into a world of unforgettable experiences at our unique hotels, where every stay is crafted to delight. From serene retreats to vibrant city escapes, let Chortoq Hospitality be your gateway to exceptional comfort and beautiful destinations.
room_des: Chortoq Boutique Hotel offers beautifully designed rooms and suites, combining modern comfort with timeless sophistication. Guests can choose from 24 Standard Rooms, a dedicated Handicapped Room, two Suites and four Deluxe Duplex Suites —Emerald, Jade, Onyx, and Topaz — for an elevated stay. The Presidential Suite provides the pinnacle of luxury, offering spacious elegance and exclusive amenities. Each room is thoughtfully designed to ensure comfort, functionality, and a seamless blend of contemporary style with local charm, making every stay at Chortoq Boutique Hotel an unforgettable experience.
room_subtitle: Where Every Room Feels Like a Retreat
sanatorium_description: The Chortoq Sanatorium is a premier well-being and rehabilitation center, nestled in the serene environment of the Grand Chortoq Resort, offering a holistic approach to health and recovery. At the heart of the Chortoq Sanatorium's treatments is the renowned Chortoq Mineral Water - a pure embodiment of nature's essence.
wellness_description: At Chortoq Hospitality, wellness is a way of life. Our expansive wellness offerings are designed to cater to every aspect of well-being, blending relaxation, fitness, and rejuvenation in harmony with nature.
